ideas.pitch: A custom CNN architecture that concatenates the sun_azimuth_angle metadata directly into the latent feature layers to overcome topographic inversion on 256x256 grayscale lunar images.
ideas.title: SunAngle-ResNet: Azimuth-Aware Lunar Feature Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core computer vision challenge of the event by treating illumination angle as a first-class feature rather than post-processing noise.

ideas.pitch: Extracts robust spatial texture and gradient histograms from lunar images and combines them with sun_azimuth_angle in an XGBoost pipeline with SHAP interpretability.
ideas.title: TopoInvert-XGB: Metadata-Enriched Gradient Boosting for Lunar Surface Classification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven tabular and vision feature extraction techniques with explainable AI to ensure robust performance on evaluation sets.

ideas.pitch: A fine-tuned Vision Transformer leveraging specialized positional embeddings derived from sun azimuth angles to correctly classify craters versus boulders under varying lighting.
ideas.title: ShadowShift-ViT: Vision Transformer for Crater vs Rise Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs state-of-the-art transformer architectures capable of capturing global spatial context across tricky lunar terrain lighting conditions.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web dashboard that visualizes misclassified lunar patches, displays confidence scores alongside sun azimuth angles, and runs live inference on test metadata.
ideas.title: LunarDebug-Dash: Real-time Pareidolia Inspection and Error Analysis UI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a polished, working live demo that helps judges instantly inspect model weaknesses and understand how lighting changes predictions.

ideas.pitch: A custom data augmentation and contrastive learning pipeline that pairs images under different synthetic azimuth angles to learn invariant representations of craters and rises.
ideas.title: AzimuthAugment: Self-Supervised Lighting Invariant Pretrainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific dataset scarcity issue by generating robust self-supervised representations explicitly conditioned on illumination variance.
